papers.title: Continuous-Latent Predictive Modeling with Semantic Alignment for EEG-Language Foundation Models (BLPM)
papers.what: Replaces masked reconstruction and discrete tokenisation in EEG pretraining with continuous latent target prediction, then decomposes the representation with multiple learned queries aligned to text semantics, reporting consistent generalisation across heterogeneous EEG decoding benchmarks.
papers.builds_on: Foundation Models for Biosignals (2025, 2XWEG7AF); MAE Theory (2023, 6INGKIJV); Sensor2Text (2024, ELYUE3NF)

papers.title: DreamX-Phi 1.0: Action-Conditioned Video World Model for Robotic Manipulation
papers.what: Injects per-arm SE(3) transforms into attention through PRoPE-style geometric encoding, plus a depth branch and SAM3 masks with a frozen V-JEPA teacher, so that predicted manipulation video stays faithful to the commanded action rather than merely realistic; first on Track 1 of WorldArena 2.0.
papers.builds_on: Navigation World Models (2024, JQ7JD8AR); DINO-WM (2025, W44RSJJI); DiT (2023, YJ9TK993)

papers.title: Spatial Memory Agent: Experience-Grounded Procedure Memory for Spatial Intelligence
papers.what: Distils verified spatial experience into compact reusable lessons carrying a Transfer Reliability Score calibrated from later retrieval outcomes, improving frozen vision-language models with no parameter updates and no external spatial tools across five benchmarks and four base models.
papers.builds_on: Memory Mechanisms Survey (2026, BDY3HUCV); LATS (2024, 77ERE7HA); PyVision (2025, XQTY5MPI)

papers.title: TailBooster: A Dual-Layer Generative Framework for Extreme Value Augmentation with Operational Validity Enforcement
papers.what: Trains a tabular VAE only on interquartile-range-extracted extremes and then rejects infeasible samples with an autoencoder-learned operational envelope, cutting downstream error by 47 to 49 percent on extreme air time and 29 to 57 percent on extreme arrival delay across six regression algorithms.
papers.builds_on: TimeGrad (2021, RILRU5H6); l-DAE (2024, DZ2UYXUL); GAN (2014, GG7GSYUJ)
